findings.description: Ciriaco Bardales and Carmen Morales had a son, also named Ciriaco Bardales, born 1 August 1905 at Guatemala City and died there 12 August 1905 aged twelve days; registered at birth on 1 Aug 1905 and at death on 13 Aug 1905.
supporting_sources: Guatemala, Guatemala, Registro Civil, 1874-2008 — death registration of 13 Aug 1905, Partida N.º 680 (ark:/61903/1:1:6D38-BQ8L; father persona ark:/61903/1:1:6D38-BQ8G): Ciriaco Bardales appeared in person to declare the death of Ciriaco, aged twelve days, "hijo natural del exponente y de Carmen Morales, solteros, ladinos, católicos, de Chiquimula y de este vecindario", at house 25, Avenida del Golfo

Guatemala, Guatemala, Registro Civil, 1874-2008 — birth registration of 1 Aug 1905, Partida N.º 1118 (ark:/61903/1:1:6KNJ-27P8; father indexed as "Ciriaco Bandales"): the same father appeared, named Carmen Morales as the mother, gave the same address (house 25, Avenida del Golfo), stated both parents "solteros ... originarios de Chiquimula la Sierra y de este vecindario", formally acknowledged the child as his son, and signed the entry

Guatemala, Guatemala, Registro Civil, 1874-2008 — the subject's own death registration of 12 Apr 1933, Partida N.º 1069 (ark:/61903/1:1:Z9YP-SKN2): aged 63, "casado con Amelia Palacios, Coronel, hijo de Josefa Bardales, originario de Esquipulas y de este vecindario" — Esquipulas is a municipality of the department of Chiquimula

findings.description: Carmen Morales was the mother of the 1905 infant — a partner of Ciriaco Bardales before his marriage to Clara Amelia Palacios Oliva. Both 1905 registrations state the couple were "solteros", so no marriage had taken place by August 1905.

person.name: Carmen Morales
person.role: named as the child's mother on both the 1 Aug 1905 birth registration and the 13 Aug 1905 death registration, described as "soltera" and of Chiquimula origin
